patterns.name: repeated_sql_injection
patterns.condition: T1190, level>=10, SQL injection/SQL syntax or database query chaining evidence, >=8 repeated requests from one source
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1190: SQL injection exploits input handling in public-facing applications.

patterns.name: repeated_script_injection
patterns.condition: T1190, level>=10, script injection marker evidence, >=8 repeated requests from one source
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1190: repeated script payload injection targets public-facing input handling.

patterns.name: repeated_path_traversal
patterns.condition: T1190, level>=10, repeated traversal/path escape evidence, >=8 requests from one source
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1190: path traversal exploits insufficient path validation.

patterns.name: repeated_command_separator
patterns.condition: T1190, level>=10, repeated command separator injection evidence, >=8 requests from one source
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1190: command injection through public-facing request parameters.

patterns.name: single_suspicious_marker
patterns.condition: T1190, level>=6, one explicit injection-like marker without repetition; exclude educational terms and normal queries
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1190: an isolated suspicious marker merits review, not automatic blocking.
